description:
Farm Steam trading cards, manage achievements, and idle games automatically — an all-in-one alternative to ArchiSteamFarm, Steam Achievement Manager, and Idle Master

Steam Game Idler (SGI) is a Steam automation tool for farming trading cards, managing achievements, and boosting playtime across all games in your Steam library.
## What's Changed
• feat(settings)：show debug logs as compact rows by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2295
• fix：improve error handling and reporting for local sign-in by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2297
• fix(i18n)：give sign-in hero words their own keys by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2301
• fix(i18n)：translate the tray's no updates notification by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2303
• chore：untrack local tooling files by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2304
• fix：load achievement icons from steam's current cdn by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2308
• libs(steam-utility)：exclude steamworks init from linux build by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2309


**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/compare/6.5.1...6.5.2
